title: Crypto VC firm Paradigm raises $1.2B to invest in ‘technical frontier’ startups
slides: Paradigm just raised $1.2 billion—what will they buy?
The firm targets only 'technical frontier' startups.
Most VCs ignored this niche until now.

thread_text:
1. Who got $1.2B?

Paradigm just raised a record venture fund—and they're only backing one type of AI startup.

2. The forgotten niche

Most VCs ignored technical frontier startups until now. Paradigm is betting on what everyone else skipped.

3. Your pool shrinks

With Paradigm hoarding capital, the remaining funding for ambitious AI builders just got smaller and more selective.

4. What qualifies?

Paradigm targets only startups pushing the bleeding edge—not apps, not wrappers. Hard tech or nothing.

5. Check now

Before your next pitch, see if your startup meets their frontier criteria. Do you qualify?
